Package arcade.patch.agent.action

Class PatchActionConvert

java.lang.Object
arcade.patch.agent.action.PatchActionConvert
All Implemented Interfaces:
Action, Serializable, sim.engine.Steppable
public class PatchActionConvert extends Object implements Action
Implementation of Action for converting cells to a different class.

The action is stepped once after TIME_DELAY. The action will select one cell located at the center of the simulation and convert it to a cell agent of the new population by removing the old cell and creating a new cell with the same age and volume.
